lead.headline: Poochinski erased 37.36. It’s still the underdog.
lead.dek: At 1:49 PM Poochinski trailed Cherry Blossom 101.8 to 64.44. At 4:48 PM it leads 148.24 to 147.5, and the live board still makes Cherry Blossom a 70.4% favorite. Sunday night decides it.
lead.pull: Poochinski 148.24. Cherry Blossom 147.5. One game left that matters, and both teams have their hands in it.
body: I’ve covered Poochinski all season, and this was its best afternoon. Down 37.36 at 1:49 PM, the franchise put up 83.8 points in the late window and walked into the evening with a 0.74 lead. That’s a 38.1-point swing in three hours. Dak Prescott did the heavy lifting, 35.14 against an 18.39 projection. CeeDee Lamb added 20.2, Jadarian Price 11.4, Brandon Aubrey 11.0 and the Seahawks D/ST 10.0. Jahmyr Gibbs’ 44.2 from the morning was the foundation; the afternoon built a house on it.

So why is Poochinski a 29.6% team while leading? Because Cherry Blossom didn’t sit still either. Christian McCaffrey had 0.6 at 1:49 PM. He finished at 46.3 against a 22.55 projection, and Cherry Blossom added 45.7 of its own in the late window. The potholes were real, Brock Bowers 3.8 in the flex and Travis Kelce 5.0 at tight end, and they still couldn’t sink it.

Here’s the board. Poochinski has two left: Aaron Rodgers (17.68) and Chase Brown (13.72), both at 5:20 PM. Cherry Blossom has three: Jaylen Warren (17.15) and Tee Higgins (17.14) in that same game, then the Ravens D/ST (8.34) on Monday at 5:15 PM. Live projection: 190.13 to 179.64, Cherry Blossom by 10.49. It’s a mirror match in one building: each team has one player on each sideline, and Cherry Blossom keeps a Monday insurance policy.

And Poochinski has a receipt it won’t enjoy. Quinshon Judkins scored 16.1 on the bench. Javonte Williams started in the flex and scored 7.7. In a game separated by 0.74, that one call is worth more than the whole margin, and it’s the first thing this front office should circle when it watches the replay.
Pick: Cherry Blossom, at 70.4%. Three bullets beat two, and the third one fires Monday. But the 9:28 AM Rodgers add now carries the week. If he’s good tonight, nobody will remember the 37.36.
